solution: We need to find what number, when 25% of it is taken, gives us 18. Let's call this unknown number n.
Set up the equation: $25\% \text{ of } n = 18$, which we write as $25\% \times n = 18$
Convert the percentage to a decimal to solve: $25\% = 0.25$. Now we have $0.25 \times n = 18$. To find n, divide: $n = 18 \div 0.25 = 72$
Check our answer: $25\% \times 72 = 0.25 \times 72 = 18$. Therefore, 18 is 25% of 72.
